name: Google Ads app campaign measurement
plain: Google Play services and the Firebase SDK report installs and in-app events straight to Google Ads.
meaning: Google already knows the click, the install and the account. The SDK adds in-app events, closing the loop with no third-party MMP.

android.store_policy: Data safety must mention ad ID, app activity; consent mode in EEA
android.api_surface: Firebase Analytics, Google Ads conversion linking, Play services
android.note: Uses Play Install Referrer and AAID on Android, SKAN and IDFA (if allowed) on iOS.

ios.store_policy: ATT; privacy manifest for Google SDKs
ios.note: iOS conversion modeling and SKAN conversion value mapping inside Google Ads.

fields.name: gclid / gbraid / wbraid
fields.range: click IDs for web and app flows

limits.headline: Can tell Google Ads about your installs and in app actions
limits.user_action: You tap a Google ad, install the app, then use it
can: Tell Google an ad led to an install, using the Play install referrer
Report in app purchases and events back to Google Ads
Use the Android ad ID, or the IDFA only if you allow it on iPhone
cannot: Send the IDFA on iPhone after you tap Ask App Not to Track
Send data you did not generate in the app
Skip Google's own matching; no outside tool is needed
limits.differs: Android uses the install referrer and ad ID. iPhone uses Apple's delayed reports and the IDFA only if allowed.

story.what_it_is: Google counts installs and in app actions straight from your phone, to prove its ads worked.

marketing.name: App campaign conversion tracking
marketing.pitch: Link Google Ads with Firebase to see which ads lead to installs and in app actions.

story.for_you: You tap an ad on Search or YouTube, install the app and play. Google quietly learns that this ad led to your install and, later, to your first purchase.
story.for_makers: Google already knows the click, the Play install and the account, so the SDK only has to add what happens in the app. That closes the loop with no third party tool, and feeds Google's bidding with real results.

use_cases.example: A studio runs an app campaign and sees which ads bring players who spend money in week one.
A retailer measures how many YouTube viewers install the app and buy within a day.
A ride app measures first ride completions after an ad install, to set its bids.
A bank counts approved accounts from ads and bids more for similar people.
Google's automated bidding learns to show ads to people like past buyers.
A growth team sends the same events to Firebase and Ads and compares the two reports.

risks: Joins ad click to in app behavior
Hard to opt out except by device reset
story.android_note: Uses the Google advertising ID and the Play install referrer.
story.ios_note: On iOS, Google uses SKAdNetwork and consented IDs because of ATT.

technical_bounds: Needs Firebase link to Google Ads

history.change: Consent Mode v2 requirements for EEA ads data (mobile and web)
